extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers (commercial and literary) who are working on or revising a novel and have a basic understanding of fiction craft
extracted.subtask_description: A six-week virtual intensive workshop focused on developing or revising a novel, teaching 'breakout' story principles (voice, character, stakes, scene craft, theme, micro-tension) through seminars, one-on-one consultations, and peer community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on story discovery
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers techniques and exercises to discover or unearth viable novel ideas or the deeper story at the heart of a project; presented as a discrete instructional unit within the intensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... strong voice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction aimed at helping writers develop a distinctive, consistent narrative voice that supports breakout potential; applied to students' specific projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standout / strong characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... standout characters (also listed among 'Breakout fundamentals' as 'strong characters')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on creating characters who stand out and propel the story; includes character development techniques and critique of students' manuscript material.

rubrics_metrics.name: The inner journey
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... the inner journey
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on characters' psychological/emotional arcs—how internal change maps to plot and theme; practical techniques for clarifying and strengthening inner journeys.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compelling story worlds
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... compelling story worlds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction on building believable, immersive settings and story worlds that enhance stakes and character choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beautiful writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... beautiful writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft guidance aimed at improving sentence-level prose, imagery, and language to elevate the manuscript's readability and resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creating resonance and finding meaning in both story and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Included are units on ... creating resonance and finding meaning in both story and process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaching how to deepen thematic resonance and extract meaning from both the narrative and the writer's creative process; helps ensure the novel feels consequential and cohesive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inner conflict
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: ... inner conflict ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques to heighten the protagonist's internal dilemmas and make choices feel fraught and character-driven rather than merely plot-driven.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal stakes
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: ... personal stakes ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction on clarifying and escalating what the protagonist stands to gain or lose on a personal level, thereby increasing reader investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot layers
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: ... plot layers ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on structuring primary and secondary plotlines, weaving subplots, and ensuring layered narrative momentum that supports theme and character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Powerful scenes
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: ... powerful scenes ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on crafting scenes with clear stakes, objectives, conflict, and emotional impact; includes scene-level revisions and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Micro-tension
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dedicated instruction on micro-tension—the small, moment-to-moment tensions that keep readers engaged within scenes and between beats; treated as a distinct craft skill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical theme techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: ... practical theme techniques ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete methods for identifying, developing, and integrating theme so it arises naturally from character and plot rather than feeling didactic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakout fundamentals (composite)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakout fundamentals are also covered: strong characters, inner conflict, personal stakes, plot layers, powerful scenes, micro-tension, practical theme techniques and much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An explicit cluster of core principles the program treats as foundational to writing a 'breakout' novel; the workshop frames these as interrelated and central to elevating a manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability to commercial and literary fiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers of commercial fiction who wish to soar out of category, as well as literary novelists who want to learn how to make powerful story principles work for them, will find the Breakout Novel Intensive an idea-packed and career enriching experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program claims the taught principles are adaptable across market categories; criterion for evaluation/production is whether story principles are being used to increase crossover or deepen literary effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assumed baseline craft knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: While writers at all level of craft are welcome, we assume a basic understanding of fiction craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should already know fundamental fiction craft concepts; the workshop builds on rather than teaches from zero—this is an entry requirement for participants to benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intensity and expected outcome
rubrics_metrics.description: “Expect to work harder than you have ever worked but to come away with a novel that is bigger and more powerful than you ever imagined you could write.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program sets an expectation of sustained, intensive effort and promises significant manuscript growth as the outcome; readiness to work hard is implied as a criterion for success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript submission & one-on-one consultation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A private thirty-minute consultation with Donald Maass, who reads fifty pages of each student's manuscript and other supporting material. After registration, email will be sent to all students including instructions for submissions (synopsis, manuscript pages, etc.) to be reviewed by Don and staff prior to the workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants must prepare and submit a synopsis and manuscript pages (typically up to 50 pages for Maass to read) ahead of the session; this is a procedural requirement that shapes the feedback and evaluation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation reading recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Many students find reading Don’s book, Writing the Breakout Novel, prior to the workshop helpful to familiarize themselves with the concepts and for greater retention and application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended preparatory reading to maximize benefit; not mandatory but advised to align participants with the workshop's core vocabulary and methods.
